record_title: Exact capacity of window-two sliding-window dynamic frameproof codes
provenance: Exact extremal theorem for q-ary sliding-window 2-dynamic frameproof codes under Paterson's unrestricted-coalition definition, with a matching explicit construction and finite sanity verification.
limitations: Specific to window length two and unrestricted coalition size. The upper bound does not apply as stated to c-frameproof variants with a fixed small coalition limit. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; current citation indexes and keyword searches are not exhaustive.
